title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct study environments inside Grand Valley State University’s Mary Idema Pew Library, spanning silent reading rooms, reservable rooms, collaborative zones, individual pods, and seasonal outdoor spaces.

cards.title: Start Flexible in the Atrium
cards.subtitle: Moveable furniture, whiteboards, and tall windows
cards.notes: Bring a group plan or a solo task, then rearrange the moveable furniture and use the whiteboards to map ideas in natural light.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, window-lined setting suited to either independent work or active collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page identifies the Atrium as a study space with moveable furniture, whiteboards, floor-to-ceiling windows, and room for group or solo work.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: The cited page does not list a reservation requirement for Atrium seating; consult current Mary Idema Pew Library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Third-Floor Reading Room
cards.title: Settle In Beside the Fireplace
cards.subtitle: A quiet third-floor room with tables, cubicles, and views
cards.notes: Choose this room for concentration-heavy reading, silence your devices, and use a table or cubicle near the 20-foot fireplace.
cards.short_summary: The fireplace distinguishes this silent reading room from the library’s more collaborative areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page says the quiet third-floor Reading Room offers work tables, comfortable cubicles, campus views, and a 20-foot fireplace.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: This is a quiet Reading Room on the third floor; the library’s current room page directs quiet-study seekers here.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Fourth-Floor Reading Room
cards.title: Take Focus to the Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet work tables and cubicles overlooking campus
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor when your assignment needs quiet focus, then choose between an open work table and a more sheltered cubicle.
cards.short_summary: An upper-floor quiet room with both communal tables and more enclosed individual seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page identifies a quiet Reading Room on the fourth floor with work tables, comfortable cubicles, and campus views.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: This is a quiet Reading Room on the fourth floor; use it in accordance with posted library access and quiet-space expectations.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Conference-Style Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Table for the Team
cards.subtitle: Enclosed rooms with a large table and whiteboard
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for a group session, arrive within 15 minutes, and use the large table and whiteboard to keep everyone on the same page.
cards.short_summary: A structured group-work option with reservable rooms across three library floors.
cards.evidence_claim: The official room page lists conference-style study rooms on floors two through four, each with a large table and whiteboard; some also have audiovisual equipment.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: Rooms may be reserved up to 10 days ahead, with up to three one-hour reservations daily; arrive within 15 minutes.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Innovation-Zone Study Alcoves
cards.title: Build Ideas Across the Walls
cards.subtitle: Third-floor alcoves with configurable furniture
cards.notes: Arrive with markers and a project outline, then configure the furniture and spread diagrams across the floor-to-ceiling whiteboards.
cards.short_summary: Three first-come alcoves designed for visual thinking and adaptable group arrangements.
cards.evidence_claim: The official room page says the third-floor Innovation Zone has three study alcoves with floor-to-ceiling whiteboards and configurable furniture.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: The three Innovation-Zone Study Alcoves are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Stacks Seating
cards.title: Work Quietly Among the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Individual seating on the east side of floors two through four
cards.notes: Walk to the east-side book stacks on floors two through four, then choose a semi-private workspace, chair, or work table for solo focus.
cards.short_summary: Quiet individual seating distributed beside the collections on three floors.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page says quiet individual study spaces surround the east-side book stacks on floors two through four, including chairs, semi-private workspaces, and tables.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: These quiet seats are located around the east-side stacks on floors two through four; no reservation rule is stated.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Collaboration Areas
cards.title: Gather at a West-Wing Table
cards.subtitle: Large tables arranged for collaborative work
cards.notes: Meet in the west wing of your chosen floor, claim a large table, and bring shared materials for a study session built around conversation.
cards.short_summary: Group-oriented seating available in the west wing on each library floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page states that Collaboration Areas in the west wing of each floor provide large tables and seating for group work.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: Find these areas in each floor’s west wing; the cited page does not state that the tables are reservable.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Individual Study Pods
cards.title: Close Out Distractions in a Pod
cards.subtitle: Three second-floor pods with a desk and power
cards.notes: Bring a charged-down task list to the Digital Creator Lab, then use a single-person pod’s small desk and power connection for quiet work.
cards.short_summary: Compact, sound-resistant individual workspaces inside the second-floor Digital Creator Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: The official room page identifies Individual Study Pods 1–3 on the second floor, describing each as a quiet single-person space with power and a small desk.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: Library patrons may use the pods during open library hours; student need may receive priority during high-volume periods.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Reading Garden
cards.title: Move the Reading List Outdoors
cards.subtitle: A seasonal garden in the center of the third floor
cards.notes: Check the weather before heading to the third floor, then bring reading or light laptop work into this seasonal open-air setting.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located outdoor alternative for fair-weather study without leaving the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page describes the Reading Garden as a seasonal outdoor study place located in the center of the third floor.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: This is a seasonal outdoor space; confirm current library access and weather conditions before planning to use it.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Roof Terrace
cards.title: Take Notes Above the Campus
cards.subtitle: A rooftop study setting intended for good weather
cards.notes: Save this terrace for a dry, calm day, secure loose papers, and bring a reading task that benefits from a change of scenery.
cards.short_summary: A weather-dependent rooftop workspace with an elevated view across campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library page identifies the Roof Terrace as a rooftop, good-weather study space with views of campus.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries - Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: The library describes this as a good-weather space; verify current library access and conditions before going upstairs.
